parameters.content:
## Workflow
* Get Method = Facebook Webhook verification
* Post Method = Chatbot System

## BLESSINGSBOT MAIN SWITCH FLOW
* GET_STARTED
Greeting message and Data Privacy Notice
* USER_AGREES
Postback direct to main system [REVIEW_MENU]
* REVIEW_MENU
Handles Displaying Menu Categories
* VIEW_POPULAR, FT, MT, SIGNATURES, BITES
Handles Displaying Menu Items
* SELECT_SIZE
Prompts user to select available drink sizes
* SELECT_ADD_ON
Prompts user to select available add-ons
* HANDLE_BITES & VIEW_CART
Handle To-Add Bites Item and directs after 'SELECT_ADD_ON'
* CLEAR_CART
Clear Cart Function
* END_SESSION
End Session Function

# BlessingsBot
Created: June 17, 2025
